dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hello, is this Nam? This is Peter Turner, the customer relations manager. I've read your email.
dialogue.reading: həˈloʊ, ɪz ðɪs ˈnɑːm? ðɪs ɪz ˈpiːtər ˈtɜːrnər, ðə ˈkʌstəmər rɪˈleɪʃənz ˈmænɪdʒər. aɪv ˈrɛd jʊr ˈiːmeɪl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, speaking. Thank you for calling.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈspiːkɪŋ. ˈθæŋk juː fər ˈkɔːlɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'm very sorry about your stay. You wrote that the hotel was far from the beach. What happened as a result?
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈvɛri ˈsɑːri əˈbaʊt jʊr ˈsteɪ. juː ˈroʊt ðæt ðə hoʊˈtɛl wʌz ˈfɑːr frəm ðə ˈbiːtʃ. ˈwʌt ˈhæpənd əz ə rɪˈzʌlt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: As a result, I had to take a taxi every day. It cost me almost two thousand baht.
dialogue.reading: əz ə rɪˈzʌlt, aɪ ˈhæd tə ˈteɪk ə ˈtæksi ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ. ɪt ˈkɔːst miː ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈtuː ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Breakfast wasn't included. Therefore, I had to pay extra every morning.
dialogue.reading: ˈbrɛkfəst ˈwʌzənt ɪnˈkluːdɪd. ˈðɛrfɔːr, aɪ ˈhæd tə ˈpeɪ ˈɛkstrə ˈɛvri ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I understand. Was there anything else?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˌʌndərˈstænd. wʌz ðɛr ˈɛniθɪŋ ˈɛls?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The air conditioning was broken on the first night. Consequently, I couldn't sleep, and I felt sick the next day.
dialogue.reading: ði ˈɛr kənˌdɪʃənɪŋ wʌz ˈbroʊkən ɑːn ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈnaɪt. ˈkɑːnsəkwɛntli, aɪ ˈkʊdənt ˈsliːp, ənd aɪ ˈfɛlt ˈsɪk ðə ˈnɛkst ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'm very sorry for the inconvenience.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈvɛri ˈsɑːri fər ði ˌɪnkənˈviːniəns.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you. But I paid for a sea view room, and I didn't get one. I think I should receive some compensation.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː. bʌt aɪ ˈpeɪd fər ə ˈsiː ˈvjuː ˈruːm, ənd aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈɡɛt ˈwʌn. aɪ ˈθɪŋk aɪ ʃʊd rɪˈsiːv sʌm ˌkɑːmpɛnˈseɪʃən.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's fair. We can offer you a refund of thirty percent. I'll also ask my manager about the taxis.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈfɛr. wiː kən ˈɔːfər juː ə ˈriːfʌnd əv ˈθɜːrti pərˈsɛnt. aɪl ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈæsk maɪ ˈmænɪdʒər əˈbaʊt ðə ˈtæksiz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you. I would be grateful if you could let me know soon.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː. aɪ wʊd bi ˈɡreɪtfəl ɪf juː kʊd ˈlɛt miː ˈnoʊ ˈsuːn.
